title: Anti-Skid System — Functional Test with Wheel Spin-Up Simulation

issue.reason: Issue D. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Wheels and Brakes — Brake Control Unit

abstract: Functional test of the anti-skid system with the aircraft on jacks, including the spin-up simulation step that proves the touchdown protection introduced with configuration standard 1.5.

sections.purpose: This task gives the functional test of the anti-skid system, including the wheel spin-up simulation that verifies the touchdown protection logic on aircraft at configuration standard 1.5 or later.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on jacks with the main wheels free to rotate and the wheel rotation rig fitted to one main wheel at a time. Electrical power and hydraulic pressure are required throughout. A second person is needed at the flight deck to select the brake modes and to read the indications, and radio contact between the two positions must be established before the test starts.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT NO PERSON IS NEAR A ROTATING WHEEL AND THAT THE JACKING POINTS ARE CORRECTLY LOADED. 2. Apply electrical power and pressurise the hydraulic system. 3. Read the configuration part number reported by the brake and steering control unit and record it. 4. Do the built-in test of the unit and confirm that the fault memory is clear. 5. Rotate one main wheel with the rotation rig and apply the brake; confirm that the anti-skid releases pressure and that the release is recorded. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT EXCEED THE ROTATION RIG SPEED LIMIT. THE TYRE IS NOT LOADED AND CAN LEAVE THE RIG. 7. Repeat for each main wheel in turn. 8. Do the spin-up simulation: rotate one wheel to the test speed, hold the second wheel stationary and apply the brake. 9. Confirm that on an aircraft at configuration standard 1.5 or later no pressure release occurs within the protection window, and that a release does occur after it. 10. Confirm that the wheel speed transducers read correctly at the regulator 210WS9 and at the switch 248WS. 11. Do the parking brake check and the alternate brake check. 12. Remove the rotation rig, depressurise the system and remove electrical power.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the wheel rotation rig is removed and that the wheels are free. Lower the aircraft from jacks. Confirm that no maintenance message remains active. Record the configuration part number, the test results and the spin-up simulation result in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The spin-up simulation acceptance criterion differs between configuration standards; use the criterion for the standard the unit reports.

safety_precautions: Make sure that no person is near a rotating wheel.
Confirm the jacking points are correctly loaded before the wheels are freed.
Establish radio contact between the flight deck and the gear bay.
